title: StepAudio 3 Realtime Technical Report
abstract: Realtime spoken interaction demands deep reasoning, prompt responses, and fluid turn-taking. We present StepAudio 3 Realtime, an audio-language foundation model organized around a continuous listen-converse-think-act loop. Deep Perception captures rich acoustic cues to interpret user intent, while Seamless Duplex models synchronized audio streams to handle pauses, backchannels, and interruptions naturally. Crucially, we resolve the tension between deep deliberation and latency via Think-While-Speaking, executing private reasoning in parallel with spoken delivery. In reasoning mode, StepAudio 3 reaches a 73.0 macro average on StepAudioChat. With Think-While-Speaking, it achieves dialogue and reasoning performance comparable to dedicated reasoning models while speaking in real time. Furthermore, an integrated Voice Agent handles asynchronous tool execution without disrupting the dialogue flow. StepAudio 3 Realtime achieves top-tier performance across key dimensions: an exceptional 90.6 on the MMSU benchmark, 98.9 Overall on the Artificial Analysis Full-Duplex Bench, and a 56.0% macro task-success rate on $τ$-Voice.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2609.14005v3 的 27 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：not-found。
analysis.ideaZh: StepAudio 3 Realtime 是196B/11B-active audio-language模型，以双audio streams处理backchannels/interruptions，两个并行调用同模型分别私有推理与分段发声，Adaptive Thinking和Medusa MTP调reasoning成本，voice tools异步返回共享context。作者报告AA duplex98.9、tau-Voice56.0及real-time StepAudioChat70.4；reasoning-mode73.0不可与实时得分混用。官方foundation report可作广域模型雷达，但无视觉/3D实验，adaptive thinking还降低reasoning质量，适合skim其并发reasoning/action机制。
analysis.motivationZh: 实时语音需要full-duplex floor control，同时保留deliberation/tool work；完整think再speak会延迟。
analysis.methodZh: 以Step3.7Flash MoE与Qwen3Omni AuT frontend共享audio/text backbone，alignment/mixed/cooldown预训1.2T tokens/32K，midtrain到128K；ASR branch和realtime branch在SFT分化。双streams以320ms blocks和state tokens建模floor，private formulate/articulate calls按audio playback协调。四specialized teachers按3:1:1:1参数merge，并保持external task status在context中。
methodFlow: audio encoder/adapter输入user及model streams，与text/history共享context
Medusa MTP加速private think，spoken response仍strict验证
analysis.experimentsZh: ASR public corpora/ContextASR，8audio-understanding tests；closed text-only StepAudioChat，AA subset duplex、AA tauVoice三域以及HMMT/GPQA/MultiChallenge。ASR专用branch非realtime转写表现。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告audio macro79.0 vsGemini3.1Pro79.4；MMSU90.6领先但AudioMultiChallenge49.3低于67.0。（Table2, PDF p.7）；作者报告tauVoice retail37.7低于Grok49.7，整体56.0稍低56.5；duplex98.9略高Qwen98.4。（Tables3/9, PDF pp.9/18） 对照范围：按任务比较不同commercial modes/versions；closed StepAudioChat不能独立公开复核，实时模式与baselines reasoning模式不匹配成本；无视觉方向对照。 消融与诊断：quality-controlled100k SFT优于随机2M、think/no-think/adaptive、MTP heads和teacher merge；MTP typical改变生成distribution，wall-clock ratios非统一设置的draft-depth对照。
analysis.insightZh: 重要官方audio-language model能力整合，核心工程是floor management、既有Mind-Paced dual-brain、adaptive reasoning、MTP及异步tool coordination。未宣称全新dual-brain范式，paper本身引用先前方法；通用视觉能力迁移尚无实验。
analysis.evidenceZh: 196B total/11B-active MoE，以Step3.7Flash和AuT audio frontend预训1.2T tokens。（Sec.3.1-3.3, Fig.3, PDF pp.3-5）；Formulation和Articulation是并行调用同audio model，短spoken segments使用已生成private reasoning。（Sec.6.3, Fig.7, PDF pp.13-14）；作者报告realtime StepAudioChat70.4、duplex98.9、tauVoice56.0；reasoning-only73.0另报。（Tables4/10, PDF pp.12/21）；Adaptive Thinking降低think rate，但reasoning从71.89降66.80。（Table5, Sec.6.3.1, PDF pp.14-15）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 官方大规模audio-language foundation report改变并发deliberation/speech/action的系统能力；对设计agents仅为可能可复用协调模式，没有已验证视觉迁移。
analysis.caveatZh: 多轮约束与retail task completion不足。；Adaptive Thinking可错误省略必要推理；低think rate不是最优分配证据。；MTP典型接受改变分布，严格spoken verification不消除未完成reasoning错误。；无视觉/3D/设计agent迁移实证，推荐是foundation-model radar的skim初值。；closed text benchmark及不完全公开训练细节限制复现；实时spoken latency/quality tradeoff不能从汇总分数替代。
